svg.aria-label: Upstream v0.9 consolidation repeat 2 shows Queue A and Queue B inside Realtime priority and Queue C inside Standard priority. Queue dots use observed peak depths in each window; the large Standard backlog is compressed. The vLLM tenant mix is inferred because vLLM telemetry is aggregate.
svg.style: font-family: Inter, "Red Hat Text", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; background: rgb(255, 255, 255);
